item.title: How to create an Express project in Node.js
item.description: Creating an Express project provides a robust foundation for building web applications and APIs in Node.js with minimal configuration and maximum flexibility. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve set up countless Express projects for backend services and API development. From my experience with Node.js, the most straightforward approach is to initialize a new npm project and install Express as a dependency. This method provides a clean starting point for scalable web applications.
